summary: Backend-only testing of J.A.R.V.I.S FastAPI. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering all 14 requested contracts. All 14 tests passed (100%). Verified /api/health flags & timezone, /api/diagnostics permissions with terminal disabled, real Claude Sonnet 5 Turkish chat via Emergent LLM key, SSE stream (event: session → data delta frames → event: done), sessions list/messages/delete, Notes CRUD + 404s, Approvals with 409 on double-decide, Checkpoints create/restore, Admin LLM never returns api_key, Council chairman uniqueness + api_key masking + delete/404, UI actions bus consumption, coding/run 503 with Turkish message referencing all 4 .env flags, Memory add + filter/search, Insight traits.

minor.issue: JARVIS_NOTES_WRITABLE flag check uses `not os.environ.get(...) == 'true'` which parses as `(not env) == 'true'` — always False, so route is effectively always writable. Not caught by tests since flag is 'true', but is a logic bug.
_get_history is fetched but never replayed into the LlmChat instance; multi-turn context relies on LlmChat's internal session store. Works but comment misleads.

action_items: Fix notes-writable guard in POST /api/notes (line 313): should be `if os.environ.get('JARVIS_NOTES_WRITABLE', 'true').lower() != 'true':` — current expression is always falsy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /notes writable guard is logically broken (see minor issue above)
chat non-stream path fetches history but doesn't feed it to LlmChat — dead code/history variable unused
SSE endpoint correctly emits `event: session` before deltas and `event: done` at end; api_key never leaked in /admin/llm or /admin/council responses (verified)
All routes correctly under /api prefix, MongoDB _id excluded from responses, no hardcoded URLs, Pydantic validation in place
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefixes (notes, council members TEST_A/TEST_B); notes/council members cleaned up within tests. Memory & audit rows persist by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully validated with 14 passing pytest tests. Only issue is a subtle logic bug in POST /api/notes writable guard that doesn't surface with current env. Frontend not tested per request scope.
